{{Quote|The great Thi-Sen, 'Son of Suns,' asks again that you leave or it will mean war.|C-3PO, to Chairman Chi Cho|<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>}}
[[File:Thi-Sen.png|thumb|right|200px|Thi-Sen, the Son of Suns]]
The title '''Son of Suns''' was referred to in an old [[The Force/Legends|Force]] prophecy that foresaw a galactic savior. Around a century prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this prophecy became the focal point for the people of [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]], in particular the [[Sun Guard]] military order. This fixation was encouraged by the clandestine [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] of that time, which usurped the savior role in order to further their agenda. By [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] time, the Guard were loyal Sith soldiers.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

"Son of Suns" was also a title belonging to [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]], a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] Chieftain.<ref name="Trespass" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|&hellip;and in the time of greatest despair, there shall come a savior, and he shall be known as The Son of The Suns.|[[Journal of the Whills/Legends|Journal of the Whills]], 3:127|<ref name="3rd">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/the-star-wars-from-the-adventures-of-luke-starkiller-third-draft|text=The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller|archivedate=20240818094359}}</ref>}}
"Son of Suns" is a reference to a prophecy that was included in the [[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|2nd]]<ref name="2nd">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/adventures-of-the-starkiller-second-draft|text=Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|archivedate=20240818175509}}</ref> and [[The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller|3rd]] drafts of the script that eventually became [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="3rd" />
